name: 四十五至五十岁的长约翰·西尔弗船长
description: 四十五至五十岁；身高约183厘米；男性低音，粗粝洪亮，英式英语口音。

attributes.movement: 以蒸汽动力机械腿稳健行走；机械臂可在金属爪、长剑、抓钩与火箭推进器形态之间转换。

variants.appearance: 四十五至五十岁，面容因岁月与战斗而粗犷，一只眼戴眼罩，留浓密胡须，身体带有疤痕，穿磨旧的海盗服装；一条腿是带活塞与齿轮的蒸汽动力机械义肢，一条手臂由黄铜与钢铁锻成，末端为可变形的重型机械爪。
variants.stage1_prompt:
45-to-50-year-old pirate captain, 183 cm tall, broad and powerful, with weathered light skin, scarred battle-lined face, thick dark beard streaked gray, swept-back dark hair, and a black eyepatch.

His navy waxed-wool command coat is cropped in front with two tapered rear panels to the calves, a high wraparound collar, and one shoulder cape. The mechanical-arm side is cut away and strapped. Brass toggles, crimson piping and lining frame a crimson waistcoat, cream sailor shirt, burgundy sash, dark trousers, and one black deck boot. The shoulders are sun-faded, the cuffs neatly mended, the piping abraded, and the openings around both prosthetics oil-darkened. Irregular blackened edges and curled char mark the cuffs, coat-tail tips, and sash ends, without open flames, smoke, or fabric patches.

A leather-and-steel shoulder socket anchors the mechanical arm. Its toothed shoulder ring, paired elbow pistons, rotating wrist collar, and cable tendons drive five articulated fingers, including an opposable thumb. Brass plates are tarnished and scratched; steel joints are oil-darkened, with repaired seams and mismatched replacements.

The prosthetic leg locks into a reinforced hip socket. Twin knee pistons flank a ratchet joint; braided pressure hoses feed a telescoping shin, sprung heel, and articulated boot-shaped foot. Worn edges, repair welds, bearing grease, and replaced fasteners show use. No deployed weapons.

Full-body on a simplified skyship deck. Complete flat-color 2D production concept, six-and-a-half-head proportions, crisp varied-width ink, opaque flat colors, minimal texture, no lighting, shading, gradients, or painterly rendering.
